notes.title: The Winter Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210437/65366b6f60d7553238153ba15220a720acf52879.png[/img]

We are very happy to announce our first content update for I Fought the Lawn is now out on experimental! You can try it out today by switching to experimental in the Betas panel.

The main focus of this first update is the addition of Snow Blowers to the equipment store, but we've added a few additional things.

[list]
[*] While it still needs visual work, a functional key remapper is now in place
[*] The backyard has been expanded, and doors opened, allowing exploration at home base
[*] There is now a practice area outside the garage in the far back of the yard
[*] Players can now access the computer from anywhere in the home base area by pressing spacebar
[*] Multiplayer - Hazard triggers are now synced across connected clients
[*] Multiplayer - Players will no longer be able to be left behind in the garage if a job is taken before they've equipped a machine
[*] Multiplayer - Players must equip the same type of machine as the host in order to take a job
[*] Job types depend on type of equipment currently in use. Mowers will show grass type jobs. Snow Blowers will show winter levels.
[*] Various stability and performance improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer - Critical update
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone for your patience over the last two days. While there are still a number of bugs left, they have been decreasing at a steady pace. Today's update represents a major fix to multiplayer functionality.

Notes:
[list]
[*]Multiplayer - Hosts will no longer have to restart their game after client disconnect
[*]Multiplayer - Clients can now disconnect and reconnect to a session
[*]Multiplayer - Clients will no longer be stuck in limbo after host disconnects
[/list]

notes.title: Day 1 patch notes - Round 1
notes.content:
We are working to fix the initial bug reports we have received. This patch represents the first of several to come over this coming week.

Release notes are as follows:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that would put the Friend List into an infinite loop
[*]Players can no longer explode themselves onto the ocean surface and walk off the map edge
[*]Multiplayer - Fixed an issue that was preventing the connected player count from resetting on game
[*]Multiplayer - Fixed an issue that was preventing the connected player count from reducing when a player disconnected
[/list]
